scientific_question: At the fourth relation exposure, how do history-dependent write generation and history-dependent recurrent expression combine to produce the observed restoration of the neural policy update?
claim_boundary: This is the final read-only mechanism-discovery closure on frozen pilot seeds 1901 and 1902. It does not train, alter architecture or checkpoints, access formal seeds, use exact posterior innovation as a trial target, or modify the existing confirmation_v1 contract.

working_theory.algorithm: meta-learned state-dependent iterative relaxation toward a posterior-like terminal potential
working_theory.generation_locus: P_(t-1) changes E_theta(e_t,P_(t-1)) and g_theta(e_t,P_(t-1)), hence the generated effective factor C
working_theory.expression_locus: P_(t-1) changes the local response R_theta(B+C)-R_theta(B) to a fixed effective factor
working_theory.matching_hypothesis: a factor generated by one history may be adapted to the recurrent sensitivity landscape created by that same history

execution_contract.seed_subject_or_relation_filtering: forbidden except the prospectively defined stable-omission retained-evidence mask
execution_contract.device: GPU for neural replay; CPU for summaries

state_and_factor_contract.natural_history: the registered accumulated fast-weight state before the current fourth-exposure relation
state_and_factor_contract.no_prior_relation_history: replay all earlier support slots while zeroing only earlier presentations of the current relation for each subject
state_and_factor_contract.natural_baseline: B_N = alpha elementwise-multiplied by the current-trial zero-magnitude final P generated from natural history
state_and_factor_contract.history_baseline: B_H = alpha elementwise-multiplied by the current-trial zero-magnitude final P generated from no-prior-relation history
state_and_factor_contract.natural_factor: C_N = alpha elementwise-multiplied by the summed matched plus-minus write generated under natural history
state_and_factor_contract.history_factor: C_H = alpha elementwise-multiplied by the summed matched plus-minus write generated under no-prior-relation history
state_and_factor_contract.factor_composition: use the exact registered C(D,E) decomposition over steps 2 and 3; no factor or cell is norm matched
state_and_factor_contract.cell_order: the first subscript indexes baseline and the second factor source
validation: Y_NN reproduces the natural matched branch
Y_HH reproduces the no-prior-relation matched branch
factor composition reproduces each summed matched write
stable-omitted current relations produce zero factors and zero cell updates

scalar_factorial_estimands.outcome: Q_ab = L2 norm of the centered potential vector Y_ab
scalar_factorial_estimands.algebraic_dependency: for any scalar cell outcome Q, M equals I / 2 exactly and is reported for interpretation but is not independent evidence
scalar_factorial_estimands.classification: a positive effect requires a paired subject-bootstrap lower bound above zero in both seeds; a suppressive effect requires an upper bound below zero in both; otherwise it is unresolved or seed-dependent

reported_vector_metrics: L2 norm of V_F, V_B, and V_I
cosine(Y_NN,Y_NH): factor source at natural baseline
cosine(Y_HN,Y_HH): factor source at history baseline
vector_and_direction_estimands.direction_boundary: positive vector norms and cosine below one describe change but are not treated as equivalence or signed factorial effects

independent_relation_target.target: for each retained fourth-exposure subject-relation, use that same subject and relation's natural matched neural-potential update at its first exposure
independent_relation_target.reason: the target is fixed by an earlier trial and avoids defining a cell as its own directional target
independent_relation_target.interpretation: positive M_A supports history-matched preservation of an independently defined relation direction; failure does not invalidate magnitude matching

bootstrap.unit: virtual subject; the eight fourth-exposure relations are averaged within subject before resampling
bootstrap.paired_comparisons: all four cells, scalar factorial contrasts, vector contrasts, and direction contrasts resample the same subjects
bootstrap.non_equivalence_rule: failure to exclude zero is unresolved and must not be called equivalence

decision_logic.generation_locus: supported if scalar F has a positive lower interval in both seeds
decision_logic.expression_locus: supported if scalar B has a positive lower interval in both seeds
decision_logic.matched_nonlinearity: supported if scalar I and therefore M are positive in both seeds; negative in both supports mismatch or suppressive interaction
decision_logic.directional_matching: supported separately if alignment I_A and M_A are positive in both seeds
decision_logic.joint_interpretation: report scalar magnitude, vector change, and independent-target direction together; do not force a single locus when effects are mixed
decision_logic.pilot_stop_rule: stop mechanism-discovery pilots when the four cells reproduce their source branches and at least one history-dependent locus or interaction is prospectively resolved across both seeds; preserve unresolved secondary contrasts as uncertainty rather than launching open-ended pilot analyses
decision_logic.confirmation_rule: after pilot closure, freeze a separate mechanism_confirmation_v1 containing only central development-supported estimands before any access to formal seeds 2001 through 2010; do not modify confirmation_v1

reporting.next_step_rule: if the pilot stop rule is met, write and push mechanism_confirmation_v1 before formal-seed access; otherwise report the unresolved closure without architecture changes
